label: NOTE: two wrappers, so every mutation moves an offset, an argument, an index or an order. The fixture is what makes them separable: three distinguishable encoder stubs AND the object's own three encoders, a pseudorandom FP block, both ring lengths V32_SYMBOL_LEN holds, counts that are deliberately not multiples of four so a forwards quadrant step shows, and a cursor seeded at 32767 over a buffer with 32,768 shorts of headroom below it.
the encoder is dispatched from the slot above the one the selector names
the encoder table is read one slot high, which is abs where V32FP_recreate laid dif
the selector is read from the two bytes above it
the selector indexes the table unsigned, which agrees over every value V32FP_recreate can leave and not over a negative one
the coder and the ring are handed to the encoder the other way round
the coder is taken from V.22's offset rather than V.32's
the shaper is filtered from a ring the encoder did not write
the encoder's count is one short, so the last data word never reaches the ring
the shaper's count is the sample count rather than the symbol count
the no-carrier index is one below the seventeenth map entry
the no-carrier index is zero, which is a real constellation point
the no-carrier index carries a mode tag in its high byte
the quadrant is stepped FORWARDS, which agrees at every count that is a multiple of four
the quadrant accumulator is masked to three bits rather than two
the quadrant is stepped once per call rather than once per symbol
the quadrant is not written back
the quadrant is taken from the coder's mode instead
the cursor wraps one short of the ring length
the cursor wraps one past it, so the slot at limit is written
the wrap test is unsigned, which agrees everywhere except at the truncation corner
the next cursor is not truncated to a short, so 32767 does not wrap to -32768
the cursor advances before the store rather than after it
the cursor is not written back, so a caller filling the ring across calls overwrites the same slots
the ring bound is read where the read cursor lives
the coder is taken from the shaper's offset
the shaper is taken from the coder's offset
